display_name: 独立时变复数滤波恢复网络源域 GPU 训练
description: 每个 IQ 时间位置独立估计 9 抽头复数及共轭滤波器并结合局部波形修正；从头训练，无 DURA、F、TX 标签、V 或目标。

data.representation: paired received/clean IQ; direct recovery uses only received IQ

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: TimeVaryingInverseRecovery width32, 9 FIR taps per time, 28166 parameters, from scratch; zero heads reproduce received IQ
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: No upstream G or F initialization or teacher; frozen DURA only after source checkpoint for diagnostics and paired test
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Random initialization; no pretrained G, F or target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 20; no source or target score selection

rows.method: Input-conditioned per-time widely-linear 9-tap FIR plus nonlinear waveform residual; no DURA input
rows.purpose: Train independent F-free network for 20 epochs
rows.seed_notes: New model initialization 2026110612; source fit 2026110611, fixed input caches and DURA seed 2026092701; optimizer ordering 2026110613.

notes: Train from scratch on paired source IQ; no DURA/F weights or outputs, TX labels, V or target during training. Frozen DURA used only after freeze for source and formal comparison.
Nine-tap complex and conjugate FIR varies per time sample; zero output heads reproduce received IQ initially.

Source-only complex-gain oracle on the previous adaptive network found that global gain/phase alone cannot account for its remaining waveform error; time variation is a hypothesis, not a proven cause.
Twenty fixed training epochs; automatic seven Phase1 views and independent truth-last scoring regardless of source metrics.
